newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi king says Israeli settlements should be halted.
- Families of two British nurses jailed in Saudi Arabia for murdering a colleague visit them in Dammam prison.
- Prince Saud to lay the foundation stone of the Saudi Chevron Petrochemicals Company in the industrial city of Jubail on March 29.
- Gulf Arab foreign ministers to meet in Riyadh on Tuesday.
- Saudi-Yemeni border committee begins meeting in Sanaa.
- Saudi Arabia, Germany agree to cooperate in the fields of trade, industry and technical training.
- Trade exchanges between Austria and Saudi Arabia totalled $400 million in 1996.
